shortDescription: According to Sina Finance, Russia's Foreign Ministry summoned the British chargé d'affaires in Moscow to protest London's continued increase in drone and other weapons supplies to Ukraine. Russia's Foreign Ministry said it reserves the right to take retaliatory measures against Britain.
